failures.title: Mercedes-Benz OM604 Engine Problems - What Actually Fails

items.title: Timing Chain Guide and Tensioner Wear - All variants
items.whatHappens: The duplex timing chain itself is robust, but the plastic guide rails and hydraulic tensioner can wear or fail over high mileage, leading to a distinct rattling noise on cold starts. If ignored, the chain can slap or jump a tooth, causing valve-to-piston contact and catastrophic engine failure.
items.repairVsReplace: If caught early, a timing chain and guide kit replacement is straightforward and cost-effective. If the engine has already suffered valve damage, a full reconditioned unit is the only viable path.

items.title: Injector Seal Weeping ("Black Death") - All variants
items.whatHappens: The copper washer seals at the base of the injectors degrade over time, allowing combustion gases to escape. This creates a black, crusty carbon buildup around the injector heads and can lead to difficult cold starts or rough idling.
items.repairVsReplace: This is a routine maintenance item, not a terminal failure. Replacing the seals and cleaning the cylinder head is inexpensive and should be done preventatively.

failures.goodYearsLine: The OM604 is widely regarded as one of the most robust 4-cylinder diesels Mercedes ever built, transitioning from the older OM601 architecture with improved refinement. Units maintained with regular oil changes routinely exceed 300,000 miles without major internal issues .

variants.title: OM604 Sub-Codes Explained - Which One Is in Your Car?
variants.intro: ═══════════════════════════════════════ INTRO: The OM604 family shares the same fundamental pre-chamber block and head design, but displacement and calibration vary depending on the chassis. Identifying your exact sub-code ensures you order the correct injection pump and ancillary components. - Fitted to: C-Class W202 (C 200 D), E-Class W210 (E 200 D) - Key technical difference: The smallest displacement variant, featuring a specific 2.0L crankshaft and mechanical injection pump calibrated for lower output. - Sub-code-specific failure note: Shares the family failure pattern above; no unique widespread defects. - Interchange note: Not a straight swap with the 2.2L variants; the engine mounts, injection pump, and wiring loom differ significantly. - Fitted to: C-Class W202 (C 220 D), E-Class W210 (E 220 D) - Key technical difference: Increased stroke to 2.2L (2155 cc) for higher low-end torque, making it the preferred choice for the heavier W210 E-Class chassis. - Sub-code-specific failure note: Shares the family failure pattern above. - Interchange note: The passenger car versions share the same core block, but the sump, oil pickup, and accessory brackets are application-specific between the W202 and W210. - Fitted to: Select export W210 models and specific commercial applications - Key technical difference: Functionally identical to the .950 in core architecture, but calibrated for specific regional emission standards or heavier gross weights. - Sub-code-specific failure note: Shares the family failure pattern above. - Interchange note: Directly interchangeable with the OM604.950 in most applications, provided the injection pump is swapped to match the original calibration.

buyingGuide.title: Buying a Replacement OM604 Engine - What to Choose

options.label: Used
options.body: A used OM604 engine makes sense only if it comes with verifiable service history and a recent timing chain guide inspection. Given the age of these vehicles, the primary risk is hidden corrosion or degraded rubber seals, so a compression test is mandatory before purchase.

options.label: Reconditioned
options.body: A proper reconditioned OM604 engine is the sweet spot for most buyers. A reputable rebuild will address the common failure points by fitting a new timing chain guide kit, updated injector seals, and a refreshed mechanical injection pump, giving the engine a fresh lease on life.

options.label: Rebuilt
options.body: A full OM604 engine rebuild is justified for high-mileage W210 estates or classic W202 restorations where originality and maximum longevity are required. An upgraded rebuild should include line-boring the block, new pistons/rings, and a balanced crankshaft.

buyingGuide.supplyFitLine: Sourcing and fitting through our vetted network ensures your OM604 engine is installed by specialists familiar with classic Mercedes mechanical diesels, backed by a nationwide warranty.
buyingGuide.vehicleValueNote: Because the OM604 is typically found in W202 and W210 vehicles valued between £1,000 and £5,000, a full replacement can represent a significant portion of the car's worth. If the lowest viable replacement cost exceeds approximately 60% of the vehicle's current market value, evaluate scrap value before committing .

items.question: How much does a Mercedes OM604 engine replacement cost?
items.answer: A reconditioned Mercedes OM604 engine typically costs between £1,300 and £2,200 for supply only . Fitted costs generally range from £1,900 to £3,000 depending on the specialist, while used units can be found from £400 but carry higher risk due to the engine's age. → Compare OM604 engine replacement quotes today

items.question: What is the most common failure on the OM604 engine?
items.answer: The most documented issues are timing chain guide and tensioner wear, alongside injector seal weeping. Timing chain rattle on cold starts is the primary warning sign of guide degradation, which can lead to catastrophic valve damage if ignored, whereas injector seal failure causes black carbon buildup around the injector heads but is a cheap and routine fix. → Get quotes for a rebuilt OM604 with these issues resolved

items.question: Which Mercedes models use the OM604 engine?
items.answer: The OM604 was fitted to the W202 C-Class (C 200 D, C 220 D) and the W210 E-Class (E 200 D, E 220 D), serving as the definitive 4-cylinder diesel for these compact and mid-size saloons and estates throughout the mid-to-late 1990s. → Check your registration to confirm your exact OM604 fitment

items.question: Should I buy a used or reconditioned OM604 engine?
items.answer: A reconditioned OM604 is strongly recommended over a used unit due to the age of these vehicles. A proper rebuild will replace the timing chain, plastic guide rails, tensioner, and injector seals, eliminating the two most common failure points, whereas used engines may appear cheaper upfront but often hide stretched chains that will fail shortly after installation. → Compare reconditioned OM604 engine prices from UK specialists

items.question: What is the difference between OM604.910, .950, and .960?
items.answer: The OM604.910 is the 2.0L naturally aspirated variant, the OM604.950 is the 2.2L naturally aspirated version with a longer stroke for higher low-end torque, and the OM604.960 is a 2.2L variant calibrated for specific export or commercial applications; they share the same core block, but the injection pumps, sumps, and accessory brackets are not always directly interchangeable without modification. → Enter your reg above to identify your exact OM604 sub-code ═══════════════════════════════════════
